dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it isn't as simple as that...

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Hmph. Sharp people always make enemies of others.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Some people were born in the sun, and thus take light and warmth for granted.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: But love, piety, holiness... all these wonderful things were built on the blood and tears of sinners.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Can you all not see it, or do you just look away?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then don't ask or think about it too much. When sin comes knocking, judgment will soon follow.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Take what I've said as a warning. Take this with you, too. I hope it will keep you vigilant.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Can I help? Have you come to confess, my child?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: I am Victoria from the church.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: I listen to confessions and, when necessary, give some guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: All kinds of spiritually edifying... guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anywhere good to go in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: My child, I sense that whatever grave sin you carry with you is weighing heavily on your heart... The best place for you now is surely the confessional?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: ...Heh. Just kidding, I say that to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: But please do not come to me with such trivial questions next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: When you are ready to repent, come and find me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: Ever since Stormterror appeared, there have been many more people coming to confession. This is an unexpected boon.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: But it matters little. Even if Stormterror hadn't arrived, I have ways and means of making people confess... of their own accord...

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: In a manner of speaking, of course. Don't think about it too much. *chuckles*
